title: Young Boy Named Cary in Sombrero, 1955 B&W Suburban Snapshot Photo
description: A candid 1955 black and white deckle-edged snapshot featuring a young boy named Cary standing on a concrete walkway outside a brick suburban residence while wearing a large Mexican sombrero. The photo captures post-war American suburban architecture and 1950s family life, complete with a date stamp of 'MAY . 55' along the photo margin.
